verdict.rationale: Lambda's billing docs state that ODC prices instances by hourly usage and bills in one-minute increments, which meets the per-minute granularity in the story. A community report of being billed for an idle but still-launched instance does not contradict this: the instance was running until terminated, and Lambda bills running instances regardless of GPU activity. missing for 10: explicit documentation that billing stops at termination or stop (no stop/pause semantics documented), per-second granularity, independent corroboration of the per-minute increments.
